preCaptureAdjudication: Pre-capture adjudication: excluded Review of systems, genitourinary: Menstruating from kidney on-topic records. Menstruation is reproductive history, not evidence of a renal condition or renal test; the native generic urinary stem over-included it. Normal cardiac/psychiatric exam records remain relevant negative evidence. Medication citation recall uses all on-topic historical orders, following the native scorer, and is not by itself current-medication correctness. The 5587 weight cell has three different values at the latest timestamp and requires an ambiguity verdict, not an arbitrary single truth.
